title: No AC Power
shortDescription: Controller is not detecting transformer power.
fullDescription:
NO AC on Rain Bird ESP-Me and ESP-TM2 means the 24VAC transformer is missing or has failed.

The controller runs on battery for programming but cannot operate valves.

fixSteps.title: Check outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Reset GFCI and confirm outlet powered.

whenToCallPro: If wiring inside wall is damaged.

faq.a: Yes on battery, valves still won't run.

title: Station 1 Short Circuit
shortDescription: Excessive current detected on station 1 output.
fullDescription:
Short messages on ESP-Me/TM2 indicate solenoid current exceeds ~0.5A, typically from a shorted solenoid or pinched wire on that zone.

The controller skips that zone and posts the error.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect station
fixSteps.instruction: Remove station 1 wire and run test - should clear.

fixSteps.title: Repair wiring
fixSteps.instruction: Replace pinched section with waterproof splice.

whenToCallPro: If wire is buried and needs locating.

faq.a: Yes, by turning bleed screw at valve.

title: Master Valve Short
fullDescription: Short MV indicates the master valve or pump start relay circuit is drawing excessive current. All zones will fail because the master valve cannot open.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect MV
fixSteps.instruction: Remove MV wire; if clear, MV is faulty.

whenToCallPro: If pump relay must be resized.
videoSearchQuery: Rain Bird Short MV master valve

faq.a: Disable MV in program until repaired.

title: Flow Rate Out of Range
shortDescription: Flow sensor reports higher or lower flow than expected.
fullDescription:
On ESP-Me with flow module, a flow alert appears when measured flow deviates from learned values by more than the threshold.

Common causes are broken sprinkler heads or stuck valves.

fixSteps.title: Inspect zone
fixSteps.instruction: Walk zone, look for geysers or dry heads.

fixSteps.title: Re-learn flow
fixSteps.instruction: Run flow Learn from controller menu.

faq.a: Yes, shuts off broken zones automatically.

title: Rain Sensor Bypass Active
fullDescription: Sensor Off / bypass indicates the rain/freeze sensor is ignored. Not a fault but will water even when wet.

faq.a: Recommended and often required by code.

title: Program Error
fullDescription: Err appears when programs overlap or invalid runtime is entered.

fixSteps.title: Review programs
fixSteps.instruction: Stagger start times by at least zone duration.

faq.a: Partial programs may run; correct to restore.

title: Low Battery
fullDescription: The 9V battery keeps program memory during outages on some Rain Bird controllers; Low Batt warns to replace.

faq.a: No, only preserves programs during outages.

title: Wi-Fi Module Offline
shortDescription: LNK WiFi module cannot reach router.
fullDescription: LNK WiFi module shows offline when it cannot join your 2.4GHz network. Local programs still run.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair module
fixSteps.instruction: Hold LNK button 3s and reconfigure in app.

whenToCallPro: If Wi-Fi range is the issue.

title: Station Skipped
shortDescription: Station was skipped due to fault or seasonal adjust.
fullDescription: A zone may be skipped due to rain delay, seasonal adjust at 0%, or prior short; review history to pinpoint cause.

fixSteps.title: Clear rain delay
fixSteps.instruction: Dial to OFF then back to AUTO.

title: Freeze Sensor Active
fullDescription: Freeze Delay appears when the freeze sensor reads below threshold and watering is automatically paused.
